mentions.description: A lightweight, MIT-licensed Rust/Tauri desktop app for private local LLMs, featuring a prompt library, chat overlay, ephemeral chat, model comparisons, and folder/RSS/URL watches.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Ekorbia: https://github.com/ekorbia/ekorbia-desktop. It's a lightweight, MIT licensed, Rust/Tauri desktop app for private local LLMs with a prompt library, chat overlay, ephemeral chat, model comparisons, and folder/RSS/URL watches.
